patterns.note: Full-width sections with varied background colors (dark teal, light grey, white) create distinct content blocks, with content consistently centered within a max-width container.

A distinctive, large, italicized serif font is used exclusively for the hero headline, creating a sophisticated contrast with the site's otherwise sans-serif typography for all other headings and body text.
High contrast is achieved through the dominant use of a deep dark teal background paired with white text and bright orange accents for calls-to-action and key elements.
A fixed background image creates a subtle parallax effect in the 'Discover more' section, while the main navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport and a promotional banner dismisses on scroll.

An extensive, multi-column footer acts as a comprehensive sitemap and resource hub, categorizing links under 'Browse Courses', 'Step-by-Step Guides', 'Complete Your Bachelor's Online Degree', and 'Earn Your Online Graduate Degree'.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport after an initial scroll, maintaining access to key navigation elements, while a top promotional banner is designed to disappear after a minimal scroll distance. A background image in a later section is fixed to the viewport, creating a subtle parallax effect as foreground content scrolls over it.
Information is presented in structured cards with subtle borders and internal padding, often arranged in responsive grids, to categorize and highlight courses or topics.
A full-width hero section features a large, italicized serif headline and a prominent call-to-action button, set against a dark, abstract background image with a subtle overlay for text contrast.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, italicized serif hero headline (~4-5x body) with bold sans-serif section titles (~2-3x body) and clear, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on cards, buttons, and input fields (small radius of ~4-8px).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing overall, with airy sections in the hero and between major content blocks, transitioning to a denser, grid-like layout for course listings and the footer.

standout: The distinctive use of a large, italicized serif font for the hero headline, contrasting with the site's otherwise sans-serif typography, creates a sophisticated and authoritative feel. This, combined with the deep teal and bright orange palette, gives the site a unique brand identity that feels both modern and established.
